H1_context_baseline.result: context explains almost none of forward movement out of sample

limitations: one instrument, one timeframe, one corpus
controls are matched on observed context; unobserved confounders may remain (rsi_14 prior_ret_16 residual SMD up to 0.50)
events per family are modest after matching (21 to 330 pairs per cell)
forward windows overlap; inference clusters by day but cannot remove serial dependence entirely
returns are price movements without costs, slippage, stops or targets
discovery month 2025-07 was used in earlier unrelated trace work and lies in the discovery period
trend_bias and ema_spread are identical events and counted once
next_experiment: frozen execution experiment (entry, stop, target, slippage, costs) to be specified separately; it is only worth running if a price-movement relationship survives the holdout, which it did not
